offering_description.value: Angi connects homeowners with local home service professionals through an online marketplace with verified reviews, upfront pricing and instant booking. It gives professionals tools to manage and promote their businesses and gives homeowners access to project financing.

quotes.quote: Angie’s List is now Angi. You’ll still find the same highly rated pros, deals, and verified neighbor reviews you’ve counted on for more than 20 years. Only now, you’ll also get access to instant booking, upfront pricing, project financing, and more to make caring for your home even easier.
With exclusive tools to manage and showcase your business, Angi increases your exposure to millions of homeowners.

To become Angi Approved — and pay to advertise services and discounts on Angi — businesses with at least one review are required to maintain an average rating of 3 stars or higher. The business’s owner, principal, or relevant manager must pass a criminal background check, and the business must maintain all applicable state and local licenses. We revoke the approval and advertising of any business that fails to maintain these requirements.
